title: World-mind learning path — give the thinking mind a way to learn (closes thinks-but-cannot-learn)
source: operator 2026-08-05T03:10Z ('this train is going lets /go') on the thinks-but-cannot-learn successor gap from ant-world-mind-network-repair (confirmed two ways: zero update call sites across 14 engine files; 300-tick pre/post weight checksums byte-identical)
description: The world-mind now reads its world (network repair) and can persist across turns (checkpoint loader) but nothing ever updates its weights: trainStep is wired only to hive networks. Design and implement the world-mind's learning signal and update path so that turns actually change the mind — the final prerequisite for the mirror experiment to measure learning rather than initialization noise.

steps.title: Learning-signal design memo (decision before code)
steps.description: Recon train-tick.js (how hives learn: signal, loss, cadence) and the world-mind's action surface (world verbs, applied outcomes, world-state deltas). Produce a short design memo with 2-3 candidate learning signals for the world-mind — e.g. (a) verb-applied/outcome reward mirroring the hive pattern, (b) a world-level objective (population/resource homeostasis delta), (c) prediction-error learning (predict next world-state features, learn from the miss) — each with: what it optimizes, what behavior it should produce, mirror-gate interpretability (does it confound the 'builds mirror features' question?), checkpoint-state footprint, and determinism story. RECOMMEND one with reasons. The memo goes to codex review BEFORE S1 implementation begins — the signal choice shapes the whole experiment and is exactly the kind of judgment that must not be a producer's silent default. REQUIRED MEMO DELIVERABLES (codex r1 MAJORs 3-4, defined at design time not left abstract): (i) for the RECOMMENDED signal, the exact signal equation (inputs, reward/loss formula, update rule, learning rate treatment); (ii) MIRROR-SAFETY CONTRACT: the explicit list of feature-coordinate inputs EXCLUDED from the reward computation, the lag structure (what tick's outcome trains what tick's decision), and a designed CONFOUND TEST — a simulated run where the signal is active but feature positions are shuffled post-hoc in analysis; if mirror-p 'improves' under shuffled features, the signal is confounded and fails; (iii) QUANTIFIED S2 TERMS: 'initialization-noise floor' = max seed-to-seed policy L2 measured across 10 fresh seeds on the repair fixture; 'frozen fluctuation band' = entropy min/max across a 300-tick frozen-mind run (both measured in the memo from existing evidence + one cheap run, becoming the S2 constants); 'monotone-ish' is REPLACED by: entropy at tick 300 departs from ln(5) by > 3x the frozen band width, and the tick-150 vs tick-300 departure ordering is consistent across both seeds.

steps.title: Implement the reviewed signal + update path
steps.description: Wire the chosen learning signal and weight-update path for the world-mind (deterministic under fixed seeds; every new mutable state — optimizer accumulators, reward traces — added to the checkpoint generation, state-inventory.md updated with a dated addition, serialization + manifest coverage extended, CheckpointManifest/1.1 (codex r1 MAJOR 1): the current single architecture hash cannot separate shape from training state — S1 versions the schema to 1.1 splitting it into shape_hash (network dims + encoder feature count; mismatch = version-stage refusal) and training_config_hash (optimizer/hyperparameters; mismatch = WARN in provenance, not refusal). checkpoint.js validation honors both; 1.0 manifests remain readable (shape_hash falls back to the legacy arch hash); the schema bump + fallback rule is itself part of the S3 trial surface). Construction-time assertions extended to the new state. CALL SITE ADOPTED (design review 20260805T034254Z): the world-train call site is run-live.js's world block (L509-557); train-tick.js is hive-only and stays UNTOUCHED (removed from files_touched). CheckpointManifest/1.1 DOMAINS SPECIFIED: shape_hash covers network dims, encoder feature count, AND the prediction head shape (Wp, bp dimensions); training_config_hash covers learning rate, loss mask E={0,1,2,3,5}, and update-rule identifiers. NEW CHECKPOINTED STATE: Wp, bp (prediction head params) and prev_features (the lazy-prediction 8-float carry) join the generation; the lazy-prediction invariant gets a construction-time assertion; SKIPPED-BLOCK RESET: when a tick skips the world block, prev_features resets to null and the next update skips (no stale-lag training) — encoded as testable behavior. 1.0 manifests report training_config_hash UNKNOWN, never 'matches'.

steps.title: Encoder/state coupling repair (F1) + re-measure (b'')
steps.description: S3-trial-confirmed F1 (codex 20260805T041202Z, world-mind.js:90-108): encodeWorldState derives coords 4 (hive count) and 7 (starvation pressure) from worldState.hives, absent from the live shared world-state.json — masked loss effectively one-dimensional. REPAIR: the shared world-state writer (run-live's world block) adds a hives summary {count, starvation_pressure} derived from the per-hive state it already holds in memory at write time (no new file reads, no membrane impact, schema_version bump on world-state, dashboard/importer unaffected structurally — verify both read paths tolerate the added key). encodeWorldState then reads real values; construction assertion extended (encoder coords 4/7 non-degenerate over a live-run fixture — dead-zero coordinates become detectable). THEN RE-MEASURE (b'') on the repaired coupling, SAME contract-hashed learning rate (0.05 — tuning to pass remains forbidden): if displacement > 0.05 with the frozen control at 0, (b'') PASSES as originally specified; if it still falls short, the live-data respecification question returns to the gate WITH the two-dimensional measurement in hand — never silently.

steps.title: Prove it LEARNS (relative criteria)
steps.description: Evidence contract WorldMindLearning/1.0: (a) weights CHANGE across a 300-tick run (checksums differ) and change DETERMINISTICALLY (same seed twice -> byte-identical final weights); (b) RELATIVE liveness recalibration per the repair worker's probe data — the respecified (b')/(d') criteria: post-learning policy diverges from its own initialization by L2 exceeding 10x the initialization-noise floor measured in mind-repair-evidence.json, and entropy trajectory shows monotone-ish departure from ln(5) (report the curve, threshold = departure exceeding 3x the frozen-mind fluctuation band); (c) learning IMPROVES the signal it optimizes (objective metric trends, n=2 seeds); (d) checkpoint round-trip mid-learning: save at tick 150, resume, continue to 300 -> byte-identical to uninterrupted across the FULL generation (weights AND optimizer state AND RNG state AND world state AND checkpoint bytes — codex r1 MINOR: not weights alone) (the A/A-prime standard now WITH moving weights — the true continuity-of-learning proof the convene wanted); (e) frozen-mind control run confirming the delta is the learning path, not incidental drift. CRITERIA ADOPTED (design review): (b-double-prime) relative parameter displacement > 0.05 vs a frozen control at exactly 0 is the PASS criterion (measured headroom 0.2146); (b-triple-prime) policy-L2 is DEMOTED to an inverted contamination alarm — under signal (c), policy displacement exceeding 10x the measured init-noise floor (0.012275) raises a contamination flag and fails the run pending diagnosis. The memo's two measured constants (floor 0.012275; frozen band width 1.2291e-6) are the S2 constants, provenance in the memo. Confound-test provenance is DETERMINISTIC: shuffle permutation seeded from turn_id, seed + permutation recorded in WorldMindLearning/1.0. D1 FORMALIZED (S3 trial ruling): the confound test's binding verdict applies ONLY when an actual mirror claim exists (mirror-detector's own thresholds: p < 0.05 AND >= 4 distinct build tiles); confounded_literal_rule is always reported verbatim alongside. A confound flag on a run with no mirror claim is diagnostic output, not a failure.

expected_outcomes: The world-mind's weights move, deterministically, from a reviewed learning signal
Mid-learning checkpoint round-trip is byte-exact — true continuity of learning
Relative liveness criteria replace the miscalibrated absolute bars as the standard
Learning deployment is cleanly a NEW operator decision, not smuggled into the stamped control
risk_notes: Signal choice can confound the mirror gate (a signal that rewards building near features would make the mirror measure the reward, not emergence) — S0's interpretability column exists exactly for this; the mirror-safe choice wins ties
Escalation: any signal requiring new courier-crossing data, or hive-training changes beyond call-site reuse
